thread:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: SLO alert triggered: inference.p99 > 1200ms for 10m. paging oncall group 'eng-sre'. link: https://dash.redwood/alerts/3109995000
OnCall Pager: Paging Alex H (primary) and Maria K (secondary). pls ack
Alex H: acked. I'm on it, joining call.
Maria K: ack. standing by for handoff.
Alex H: quick context from alert: p95 ~ 420ms, p99 ~ 1.3s; streaming stalls observed (clients report partial chunks then long gap). Error rate up ~0.4% but spikes correlate with latency.
Jamal R: jumping in — initial hypothesis: auth/configstore calls upstream to configdb are blocking inference path (seen before with large fanout).
Elaine S: i'm seeing a controlplane trace sample: many requests waiting on 'config_fetch' RPC, RT ~800-1500ms. tail is worse for streaming sessions.
Ryan L: adding logs from gateway: ``ERROR: feature-flag-service timeout after 1.2s`` and ``auth: token lookup latency 900ms``. Several retries.
Alex H: what's the traffic pattern? any rollout?
Sophia T: no recent model rollouts in last hour. There's a canary for a flag in eu-west but deploy completed 2h ago.
Maria K: customer impact: initial reports from 6 customers using streaming endpoints — sees stalls/reconnects. SRE notes 12% increase in user-visible stalls.
OnCall Pager: please triage p99 and confirm mitigation plan.
Alex H: running quick rollup of traces -> `rg 'config_fetch' /var/log/traces | head` shows many long waits. Suggest stepping through controlplane DB (configstore) metrics.
Jamal R: configstore latency graphs: spike aligns w/ alert start, read p99 ~ 1.1s, QPS flat. Looks like contention or a hot key fanout.
Elaine S: digging into configstore leader logs; seeing repeated leader heartbeats delaying read path due to GC pause on small cluster node. Not conclusive yet.
Ryan L: can we temporarily route inference to cached config snapshot to bypass live config fetch?
Maria K: we have a per-request 'fresh_config' bit default true. If we flip to prefer cached for 5m, will reduce fanout. Risk: feature flag changes delayed. Need approval.
Alex H: recommended mitigation: 1) set fresh_config=false for inference route (rollout 100% with 30s ramp), 2) increase configstore read timeouts & add short-circuit to cached copy in gateway, 3) monitor error/latency.
Sophia T: agree. Who can flip the flag?
Elaine S: I can do it in controlplane. Preparing the canary script.
Jamal R: also let's throttle non-critical background workers that hit configstore to reduce load.
OnCall Pager: action items summarized: Elaine -> flip fresh_config toggle; Jamal -> throttle background jobs; Alex -> watch p95/p99 and streaming stalls; Maria -> contact affected customers w/ ETA.
Elaine S: executing toggle now: ``PATCH /controlplane/v1/routes/123 {"fresh_config":false}`` -> response 200. Rolling 30s.
Alex H: flagged successful. Observing initial metrics: config_fetch lat p99 dropping from 1.3s -> 250ms within 40s.
Ryan L: streaming tails reducing, chunk gaps down. Error rate trending down. :thumbsup:
Maria K: notifying customers: "We've detected increased latency in streaming endpoints affecting tail latency. We've applied a temporary mitigation that reduces live config fetches. Monitoring closely; follow-up with RCA and timeline after triage."
Sophia T: note for postmortem: why did configstore GC/node pause correlate with higher tail latency? Need root cause (gc config, compaction, or hot key?).
Jamal R: throttling background jobs now (kill -SIGSTOP on batch workers) — will keep paused for 15m.
Alex H: p99 now ~210ms for inference, p95 ~380ms. Streaming stalls largely cleared. Marking incident state: mitigated but not resolved.
OnCall Pager: good. Start RCA timeline capture. Ask Eng-Infra to run heap/profile on configstore nodes.
eng-infra-bot: scheduled debug snapshot job on configstore-2 (id cf-2) at 3109995365, collection id debug-3109995.
Elaine S: debug job started. uploading heapdump to s3://redwood-debug/cf-3109995.gz
Ryan L: observed repeated hot key for path `/project/flags/enterprise/` — single customer with many feature flag keys causing fanout. We'll need to examine client behavior.
Maria K: Customer impact table: 6 customers minor (increased latency), 2 customers moderate (streaming disconnects), 0 severe. No revenue-impacting alerts yet.
Alex H: plan for next 2 hours: keep fresh_config=false, keep background throttle, investigate hot key, prepare rollback plan to re-enable fresh_config via rapid canary if safe.
Jamal R: collecting traces for deeper analysis. Will add tags: `hotkey`, `config_fanout`, `gc_pause`.
Sophia T: schedule follow-up call in 1h for RCA draft.
Maria K: oncall handoff note: if incident persists beyond 2h, escalate to Eng-Platform and Customer Success.
Elaine S: heapdump shows increased fragmentation and mark-sweep pause spikes on cf-2; engineering note filed: https://tickets.redwood/CF-7891
Alex H: marking incident as "mitigated" in incident tracker. p99 back under SLO. Keeping thread open for RCA and action items.
OnCall Pager: handing over to night shift: Ryan L will be primary until 0700 UTC, Jamal R secondary. Please update rotation.
Ryan L: ack. I'll keep watch and escalate if p99 creeps above 500ms.
Maria K: will draft customer postmortem note after RCA completes.
Alex H: thanks all. Closing active mitigation but leaving thread open for RCA notes and postmortem drafts.
